native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: In the 17th century BCE (the CE -1700 / 1700 BCE 100-year bin), the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses while the Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneously. Specifically, from 1800 BCE to 1700 BCE the PotteryForm Z-score falls from +0.74 to -1.13 (a -1.87 collapse to its all-time low, where it remains flat for the following 1,200 years) while the PotteryDecoration Z-score rises from -0.48 to +0.97 (a +1.45 increase, continuing to +1.53 by 1000 BCE). This is the only 100-year bin in the series where Form declines and Decoration rises together, it is by far the steepest Form collapse, and it is independently confirmed by the capital.csv ZKeform/Zkeverz series.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) Parsed time_series_data.csv (3,601 rows, CE -4100..-500, 1-yr grid) and capital.csv (39 rows, BCE 4300..500, 100-yr grid, decimal-comma format converted to dots). 2) Extracted the true 100-year resolution of the pottery Z-scores: the raw PotteryForm/PotteryDecoration columns are populated at only 37 evenly spaced 100-yr points (the _inter columns are pure linear interpolation and were not used for detection). 3) Computed first differences (dForm, dDeco) between consecutive 100-yr bins and flagged bins where Form_down (dForm<0) and Deco_up (dDeco>0) hold simultaneously. 4) Selected the bin with the steepest sustained PotteryForm collapse (largest negative dForm, excluding the -4100->-4000 baseline artifact) that is paired with a simultaneous Decoration increase, and verified the post-event Form level stays at its minimum (sustained, not transient). 5) Mapped the selected CE value to a calendar century (CE v = |v| BCE; Nth century BCE begins at 100*N BCE) and attributed the event to the century beginning at the point carrying the new value. 6) Cross-checked against capital.csv ZKeform/Zkeverz: all 36 shared bins (excluding the BCE-500 artifact row) match exactly. Executed script: analysis.py.
